Method of Attack: Spreads through emails containing Word documents with malicious macros
Downloads and installs malware via malicious macros in Word documents
Uses infected computers to send spam emails and install other malware
Steals stored passwords, bank information, and other data
Leads to ransomware attacks on victim's network
Attack Vector: Email attachments with malicious Word documents and macros
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious Word (.doc) attachments or links in spam emails
Prompts to 'Enable Editing' and 'Enable Content' to run macros
